purpose: Make God Mode development measurable across the core SEIS modules and five required ecosystem layers.

modules.newFeature: God Mode operating overview that shows module coverage, quality gates, and current ecosystem posture in one cockpit surface.

product-experience.evidence: Dashboard exposes a concise operating view for progress, gaps, and next build slices.
product-experience.riskGate: No dashboard work is complete without showing the user what changed, what is blocked, and what needs validation.

application-platform.evidence: Dashboard state is backed by explicit contracts instead of hard-coded prose.
application-platform.riskGate: No dashboard-only mock may be treated as platform progress.

ai-agi-learning.evidence: Dashboard reports AI/agent signals, learning mode, and decision trace status.
ai-agi-learning.riskGate: AI claims must map to a contract, event, or documented capability.

cloud-security.evidence: Dashboard includes security and deployment-readiness posture before release claims.
cloud-security.riskGate: No deployment-ready label without security and rollback evidence.

governance-quality.evidence: Dashboard links each feature slice to a quality gate and acceptance evidence.
governance-quality.riskGate: No visual feature can bypass governance checks.

acceptanceEvidence: Visible cockpit surface or contract-backed view
modules.nextBuildSlice: Add a dashboard module card that reads this coverage contract and flags missing evidence.

modules.newFeature: God Mode goal ledger that separates active objectives, completion evidence, blockers, and long-horizon roadmap slices.

product-experience.evidence: Goals are understandable as user-facing outcomes, not only engineering tasks.
product-experience.riskGate: No goal can be marked complete without explicit evidence.

application-platform.evidence: Goals use durable records and stable fields for status, owner, gates, and evidence.
application-platform.riskGate: No invisible or undocumented goal state.

ai-agi-learning.evidence: Goal updates preserve learning signals, assumptions, and decision rationale.
ai-agi-learning.riskGate: No autonomous goal update without auditability.

cloud-security.evidence: Goals that affect cloud, secrets, deploy, or data require security gates.
cloud-security.riskGate: No goal may weaken privacy, secret handling, or rollback readiness.

governance-quality.evidence: Goals are tied to acceptance criteria, validation commands, and rollback notes.
governance-quality.riskGate: No roadmap item may bypass quality gates.

modules.nextBuildSlice: Add a goals module ledger that maps every active objective to validation evidence and rollback readiness.

modules.newFeature: God Mode repository governance layer that tracks repo health, plugin readiness, CI posture, and publish safety.

product-experience.evidence: Repository health is visible as maintainability and contributor-readiness, not hidden shell output.
product-experience.riskGate: No repo change is complete if user-visible repo health regresses.

application-platform.evidence: Repo scripts, packages, plugins, and apps are mapped to supported platform surfaces.
application-platform.riskGate: No untracked platform lane or orphaned script.

ai-agi-learning.evidence: Repo plugin and agent capabilities are declared and checked.
ai-agi-learning.riskGate: No AI/plugin capability without manifest and checker coverage.

cloud-security.evidence: Repo gates cover CI, secrets safety, publish readiness, and rollback notes.

governance-quality.evidence: Repo governance uses mandatory checks for docs, security, quality, and architecture consistency.
governance-quality.riskGate: No repository slice can bypass CI-linked governance.

modules.nextBuildSlice: Add a repo health manifest that summarizes required checks and missing governance files per repo lane.

modules.newFeature: God Mode documentation system that turns architecture, quality gates, AI policy, and module coverage into living contracts.

product-experience.evidence: Docs explain what exists, why it exists, and what the user can do next.
product-experience.riskGate: No feature may ship with only code and no operating guidance.

application-platform.evidence: Docs link contracts, scripts, apps, plugins, and package commands.
application-platform.riskGate: No stale doc claim without a repo artifact.

ai-agi-learning.evidence: Docs describe AI boundaries, autonomy limits, learning loops, and evidence requirements.
ai-agi-learning.riskGate: No AI policy gap for autonomous or agentic behavior.

cloud-security.evidence: Docs include security, privacy, deployment readiness, and rollback expectations.
cloud-security.riskGate: No operational doc can omit security impact.

governance-quality.evidence: Docs define acceptance criteria and are checked by quality gates.
governance-quality.riskGate: No documentation-only artifact without quality linkage.

modules.nextBuildSlice: Add a docs index that links manifesto, quality gates, AI policy, and God Mode coverage.

modules.newFeature: God Mode agent operating model that defines safe autonomy, tool boundaries, plugin capabilities, and validation duties.

product-experience.evidence: Agent behavior is legible to users through status, scope, and next-step reporting.
product-experience.riskGate: No invisible agent action without observable outcome.

application-platform.evidence: Agent skills, manifests, and MCP/plugin hooks are declared as platform assets.
application-platform.riskGate: No agent feature without source-controlled capability definition.

ai-agi-learning.evidence: Agents capture reasoning boundaries, learning signals, and evaluation gates.
ai-agi-learning.riskGate: No autonomous claim without validation and controllability.

cloud-security.evidence: Agents follow least-privilege, secret-safety, and non-destructive operation rules.
cloud-security.riskGate: No agent may expose credentials, bypass approval, or weaken rollback posture.

governance-quality.evidence: Agents are checked for skill presence, manifest coverage, quality gates, and docs.
governance-quality.riskGate: No agent lane can ship without policy and checker coverage.

modules.nextBuildSlice: Add agent lane status that shows which skills are active, checked, and safe to use.

30Days: Expose module coverage in the demo dashboard.
Create a goals ledger with validation and rollback fields.
Make repo health and plugin readiness visible through checked manifests.
Add docs index for architecture, quality, AI policy, and God Mode coverage.
Add agent lane status for skill, manifest, and safety boundaries.
90Days: Connect module coverage to real product telemetry and release gates.
Turn goals into a durable ecosystem planning system.
Expand repo governance across all SEIS packages, apps, plugins, and docs.
Create living documentation that is regenerated from source contracts where practical.
Evolve agents into safe, observable, policy-bound development operators.
